description:
Create a PERT Chart (Network Diagram) for a construction renovation project based on the schedule provided in '~/Desktop/renovation_schedule.txt'.

1. Open draw.io and create a new blank diagram.
2. Create a node for each of the 10 tasks listed in the schedule file. Label them with the Task Name and Duration (e.g., 'Demolition (10d)').
3. Draw arrows representing the dependencies (Predecessors -> Successors).
4. IDENTIFY AND HIGHLIGHT THE CRITICAL PATH: The schedule file identifies the Critical Path sequence. You must style the arrows connecting these specific tasks to be RED and THICK (at least 3pt width). All other arrows should remain default (black/thin).
5. Save the diagram as '~/Desktop/pert_chart.drawio'.
6. Export the diagram as a PNG image to '~/Desktop/pert_chart.png'.
